subject.title: feat(openrouter): forward OpenClaw session id as session_id

question: Should OpenClaw support this OpenRouter-specific, default-off `forwardSessionId` setting and send its derived session correlation identifier in the chat-completions body?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally additive, but the accepted configuration location/name and the policy for exporting stable session-derived identifiers to a third-party provider are product and privacy-contract choices rather than mechanical repair decisions.

options.title: Approve plugin-local opt-in
options.body: Accept the provider-owned `forwardSessionId` setting after current-head live proof confirms the documented opaque request value and route scoping.

options.title: Prefer a different supported surface
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers specify a different configuration or provider-runtime contract for session affinity.

options.title: Decline identifier forwarding
options.body: Close this direction if OpenRouter session correlation should not be exposed from OpenClaw sessions, even in derived opt-in form.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-local opt-in
recommendation.body: Accept the provider-owned `forwardSessionId` setting after current-head live proof confirms the documented opaque request value and route scoping.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline records direct involvement during initial review, while the unresolved question is product direction rather than a narrow code repair.
